content.title: When Index Deletion Carries News: MSCI Reviews, Free-Float Credibility and Price Pressure in Indonesia
content.abstract: We study 160 MSCI index review events for 96 Indonesian stocks from 21 quarterly reviews between 2021 and 2026; because not every review changed Indonesian membership, additions and deletions each fall on 16 announcement dates. Additions earn a cumulative abnormal return of + 3.8% over days [− 1,+1], significant even when each announcement date counts as one observation (p = 0.023), followed by a reversal of similar size that is not significant at the date level.
